apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 191 is a fresh Release archive of the clean consolidated PR branch cb7d3299. Includes final Metal 4 presentation/pacing and near-native MetalFX, vibration/shortcuts, Standard split-pad Hide/Show, GeForce NOW layout/editing, immersive mode, optional HUD metrics and Sessions duration/battery history. App code is identical to tested Build 190; discarded Mobile Game gameplay and old G-Sync/deadline experiments are absent, with saved-settings migration retained. 223 simulator tests passed on the identical tree, one hardware-only skip. App/widget 1.1.191/191 and unsigned ZIP verified. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
